routes.route: ROUTE 4 — HYBRIDS AND TRIVIALITY (boundary-drawing power of the factorization form F)

per_exemplar.exemplar: E1 — Flavor invariants / theta-bar (strong CP)
per_exemplar.finding: HYBRID, boundary STATEABLE — but only in stratified form, and the Stage-1 gloss is overclaimed as written. (1) The boundary F can state in advance, computed from forced structure and never from the measured value: theory-side = the quotient, its stratification, and all derived structure ON the image including its distinguished loci (theta-bar's circle S^1, its exact non-running, the CP-restoration locus near theta-bar=0, and the theta-bar–rank interlock of kernel element 34); state-side = stratum selection plus residual coordinates (the value). The <1e-10 observation prices the point; F does not claim the theory explains it. (2) The naturalness attack does NOT kill: 'the point's location is law-explicable' is, on inspection, always a demand for a DIFFERENT theory (axion: promote theta-bar to a field, the anomaly-generated potential selects theta-bar=0 — the coordinate migrates from point-side to Phi-side via dynamical selection). Within the audited SM the split is clean and the kernel file itself says why ('no known dynamical origin', element 33). (3) Two genuine narrowings extracted: (a) STRATIFICATION — the '13(+theta-bar)' dimension F3 advertises is the GENERIC-stratum value; rank(Y_u)=3 is point-side data (elements 27, 34: a massless up quark deletes theta-bar from the image entirely). So 'the theory derives dim(Y/G_F)' must be read as 'the theory derives the dimension FUNCTION over strata; the data select the stratum.' Stage-1's E1 paragraph states the unconditional form and is to that extent wrong. (b) EXPRESSIVE LIMIT — F classifies theta-bar and the Cabibbo angle identically (point coordinates on derived spaces); the community's felt difference (theta-bar's unprotected proximity to a derived distinguished locus, with CP already CKM-broken so 't Hooft protection fails) is inexpressible in F. F's boundary is well-defined but it is not the explanation-boundary as practice draws it. Not a kill — F never claimed normative force — but a documented limit.

per_exemplar.exemplar: E4 — zeta / primordial spectrum A_s(k), n_s
per_exemplar.finding: HYBRID, boundary STATEABLE in advance by a principled criterion already latent in the record — but with the route's sharpest genuine failure attached. (1) The in-advance criterion (kernel element 40's own vocabulary, 'relations rather than parameters'): theory-side = everything holding identically across im(Phi) or derivable as its structure — near-scale-invariance as a basin-conditional inequality |n_s−1| = O(eps,eta), the consistency relations n_t = −r/8 and f_NL^sq = 5(1−n_s)/12, zeta-conservation, rank one per mode; state-side = coordinates varying within the class — the values A_s, n_s, running. This splits the spectrum without consulting Planck. (2) Stratification again: the basin boundary (USR, element 9) is derived from V, but V is upstream-supplied — so whether Phi even acts, and what survives (consistency relation violated, f_NL^sq = 5/2, erased data resurfacing in the squeezed bispectrum), is stratum-dependent with stratum selection supplied. The product reading of F fails here exactly as in E1; the stratified reading survives. (3) GENUINE FAILURE — S-relativity of the boundary: at framework level (single-field, V free) n_s is point-side; at universality-class level (alpha-attractors, element 38, verified: n_s = 1−2/N, r = 12alpha/N^2, Kallosh–Linde) n_s becomes DERIVED, with only (alpha, N) point-side — and N itself is partially derived from reheating history (element 41). The space/point boundary moves with the declared specification space S, F states it per-S, and F has no resources to say which S is 'the theory.' The question 'is n_s law-fixed or state-fixed?' has no F-answer simpliciter, only S-indexed answers. This is the recorded content-selection gap (K_ROUND_INSPECTION §5) resurfacing INSIDE F's boundary-drawing power, and it is the boundary this route contributes to the Stage-2 success criterion.

Deeper grammar point: d is CONSTITUTIVE of every audited specification space S (every exemplar's S is built at fixed d — even E3's Chern classification is d-dependent), so d sits on the Phi-defining side in every audited factorization and can never be an image coordinate of any of them. Theory-relativity again, not post-hoc absorption.

per_exemplar.exemplar: T2 (hostile item ii) — gauge group SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1)
per_exemplar.finding: CLEAN REFUSAL, sharper than T1, with a decisive extra argument. (1) On the audited record the gauge group is Phi-SIDE data: it DEFINES the gauge-orbit quotient A -> A/G; kernel element 21 states the global form 'is not a direction in A' — the quotient cannot reach it. A parameter of the map is not a point of its image; F's grammar locates it without consulting anything. (2) Anomaly cancellation (element 9, THEOREM) derives constraints on the allowed (G, reps) set, but the record itself draws the line: 'the anomaly is in the kernel; the selection of a point in the allowed set is not' — a constraint set is not the image of a forced many-to-one Phi from any theory-internal S. (3) The E3-mimic (G as deformation invariant of theory space) fails WELL-DEFINEDNESS, not just forcedness: Seiberg duality (verified) maps SU(N_c) with N_f flavors to SU(N_f−N_c) with the same IR physics — dual descriptions of one theory carry different gauge groups, so 'which gauge group' is not even a function on physically-individuated theory space. The invented Phi_G does not exist to be forced. (4) F2 also fails on the record (PRICED_INVENTORY_48: 'underived but boundary-uncontested', MANY-PREPARATIONS/STABLE-LAW — no audited fibre). Net: F cannot absorb the gauge group as an image-point, and its refusal is principled: it classifies G as maximal-severity Phi-side supplied structure, the E5 model-class flag at full strength. That is F doing real work.

routes.argument: ROUTE 4 VERDICT ARGUMENT. (A) TRIVIALITY TEST — F PASSES, and this is the route's main pro-F result: both hostile items are refused by F's own conditions, computed in advance. F1 blocks every invented Phi for d and for the gauge group because 'forced' requires a theorem-grade structure internal to a declared theory, and both items are constitutive of every audited theory's specification space — they sit on the Phi-defining side of every factorization on the record, never in any image. F2 independently blocks them: no exhibitable fibre exists on the record (K-round, verbatim: irreducibility is not compression; no audited 'before'). The strongest mimicry — copying E3's 'discrete deformation invariant' shape — fails F1 for d (no theorem supplies the meta-space topology; E3 has Hastings–Michalakis, the mimic has nothing) and fails well-definedness for the gauge group (Seiberg duality: dual descriptions of the same physics carry different gauge groups, so G is not a function on theory space at all). Because F demonstrably CANNOT absorb these, its absorptions elsewhere are not post-hoc taxonomy: the K-U lesson does not transfer to F on this route. (B) HYBRID HUNT — F survives but only NARROWED, in three recorded ways. (1) The product reading of F ('theory derives the map and the space; state supplies the point') is DEAD: in E1 the image structure itself is stratum-dependent with stratum selection supplied (rank(Y)=3 is point-side; the 13-count is the generic-stratum value; theta-bar exists as image data only on that stratum — element 34), and in E4 Phi's action and what survives are basin-dependent with basin membership supplied (USR, element 9). Stage-1's unconditional 'the theory derives dim(Y/G_F)' is overclaimed as written. The stratified reading survives: the theory derives the stratification, the dimension function over strata, distinguished loci, and cross-image identities; the state supplies stratum plus residual coordinates — and this boundary IS stateable in advance because the stratification is computed from forced structure, never from measured values (the record proves computability: the blinded agent derived the USR boundary and the theta-bar–rank interlock without corpus access). (2) The boundary is S-RELATIVE: E4 shows the space/point split moves with the declared specification space (framework-level: n_s point-side; alpha-attractor class: n_s = 1−2/N derived, only (alpha, N) supplied, N itself partially fixed by reheating). F states the boundary per declared S and does no work choosing S — the content-selection gap resurfaces inside F's boundary-drawing power. This is the genuine boundary this route contributes to the pre-registered success criterion's clause (b). (3) EXPRESSIVE LIMIT: F classifies theta-bar and the Cabibbo angle identically; naturalness — the practice of treating certain point-locations as law-apt — has no slot in F, so F's boundary, though well-defined, is not the explanation-boundary physics practice draws. Naturalness demands turn out, on inspection, to be demands for a different theory in which the coordinate migrates to Phi-side (axion: dynamical selection), so this is a limit, not an inconsistency. (C) NET: no kill on this route. F's boundary-drawing power is real (two principled refusals; an in-advance hybrid criterion — derived stratification and cross-image relations vs residual coordinates — grounded in kernel elements 9, 34, 40) but strictly weaker than Stage-1 advertises: F survives only as stratified, S-indexed F, with its dimension-counts stratum-conditional and its refusals record-relative. Verdict: F-SURVIVES-NARROWED. Compatible with honest reporting of the success criterion: this route supplies clause (b) (a genuine boundary — S-relativity plus death of the product reading); clause (a) (canonicity of some Phi) is route 1's business and is neither claimed nor prejudiced here.

The derived/supplied boundary is computable in advance for each declared S — derived = whatever is constant across or structural on im(Phi), supplied = whatever varies within it — but it is S-relative: F provides no trans-theoretic boundary, no criterion for choosing S, and no marking of 'law-apt' point locations (naturalness lies outside F). routes.route: ROUTE 1 — COORDINATE DEPENDENCE: attack on F1 ("Phi is forced") — is each exemplar's Phi canonical (presentation-independent in a stated precise sense) or an artifact of parameterization?

per_exemplar.exemplar: E1 — Flavor invariants (Phi = quotient map Y -> Y/G_F, invariant ring)
per_exemplar.finding: CANONICAL in a two-part narrowed sense; the naive reading of F1 dies here. (i) TARGET-CANONICITY holds absolutely: every known presentation of flavor physics supplies a point of the SAME 13-dimensional moduli space with the same derivable structure. Spurion analysis IS the quotient restated (physics depends only on G_F-invariant spurion combinations = functions on Y/G_F). The Bernabeu–Branco–Gronau CP-odd conditions (Phys.Lett.B 169 (1986) 243) are traces of powers of mass matrices — elements of the same invariant ring R[Y]^{G_F}, not a rival map. On-shell massive-spinor-helicity constructions of the electroweak/SM sector (e.g. arXiv:1909.10551, arXiv:2305.02502) supply masses, mixing magnitudes and the CP phase directly. No presentation is known that yields a DIFFERENT image — that would have been the kill, and it does not exist. (ii) WITHIN the class of local-field (Lagrangian) presentations Phi is category-forced: G_F = U(3)^5 is the derived automorphism group of the kinetic term, not a choice, and the invariant-theoretic quotient has the universal property — every invariant map factors through it. BUT the attack lands a real narrowing: the FACTORIZATION AS A MAP is presentation-class-relative. The on-shell presentation exhibits the same physics with no G_F quotient anywhere — the domain Y (Yukawa tensors) never exists, so the 26-dimensional fibre and F2's many-to-one character are bookkeeping of the covering presentation, not presentation-absolute facts (residual on-shell redundancy is only external-state rephasing, removable by supplying invariants directly). The saving asymmetry, which keeps this CANONICAL rather than demoting it: a quotient-free presentation must IMPORT what the quotient presentation DERIVES — the count 13 (Jenkins–Manohar JHEP 10 (2009) 094: Krull dimension of the invariant ring = number of physical parameters), the syzygies (the ring is non-free, JHEP 03 (2011) 096), the unitarity/|J| constraints. 'The same physics, no quotient anywhere' exists as a presentation but not as a derivation: F3 is precisely what Phi buys, so Phi is canonical as the universal derivation of a presentation-absolute image — every presentation either contains it or borrows its outputs.

per_exemplar.exemplar: E2 — Branch weights (Phi = restriction to the fixed-point/pointer algebra A, given the S-E split)
per_exemplar.finding: The route's genuine failure. Phi_E2 is a two-stage map and only stage 2 is forced. Given the split and H_int, the commutant/fixed-point-algebra construction is basis-free and THEOREM-grade (Schur-multiplier argument, verified in the kernel file): canonical relative to its input. But stage 1 — the tensor factorization H = H_S (x) H_E — is a supplied presentation datum, not a theorem output: a bare Hilbert space plus Hamiltonian carries no preferred factorization; deriving one is an open research program (Carroll–Singh, Phys.Rev.A 103, 022213 (2021), arXiv:2005.12938 — who state the choice is 'begged rather than addressed' in almost all applications), with published arguments that a unique factorization/preferred basis CANNOT emerge from the spectrum alone (arXiv:2102.08620). Different admissible cuts give different H_int, different commutants, different pointer algebras A, different simplices Delta^{n-1}: Phi_E2 is a FAMILY indexed by an unpriced supplied structure. The program's own ledger anticipated this — AMENDMENT 01 classifies the S-E split as the type-error class (a contraction-DEFINING parameter, not a kernel element) and the split row was one of the seven discounted showcase rows. Decisive against F1 AS STATED: F1's text flags E5's model class as the priced choice-residue but grants E2 no such flag, so F1 asserts unconditional forcing where only conditional forcing exists. The locality rescue (fundamental interactions are quasi-local, hence pointer bases are quasi-position) moves the forcing upstream to spacetime structure but still does not select WHICH degrees of freedom are 'the system'; absorbing the cut as an argument of Phi is exactly trap-4 post-hoc absorption. Verdict: conditionally canonical, condition unflagged — F1 false at E2 as written; repairable only by moving E2 into the E5 column (split flagged and priced).

per_exemplar.exemplar: E3 — R_K / Chern number (Phi = locally constant map C: G -> Z; supplied datum = point of pi_0(G))
per_exemplar.finding: CANONICAL for the priced instance, with the attack succeeding against the TYPE and thereby drawing the route's sharpest boundary. The class attack is real: pi_0(G) is a function of the DECLARED admissible-deformation class — the tenfold way (Kitaev; Ryu–Schnyder–Furusaki–Ludwig) is literally the table of that dependence, and Pollmann–Berg–Turner–Oshikawa (arXiv:0909.4059) prove the Haldane phase is adiabatically connected to a trivial product state once all three protecting symmetries are broken. For SPT-type invariants the declared class is a supplied input to Phi and F1 fails. But the priced exemplar sits in the CLASS-MAXIMAL stratum, and that is a precise, checkable canonicality sense: Hastings–Michalakis (arXiv:0911.4706, verified) assume only finite-range/finite-strength interactions, a spectral gap, a unique ground state, and a conserved local charge — no antiunitary or discrete symmetry declarations — so the Chern integer separates components of the MAXIMAL admissible class; enlarging the declared class (allowing any further symmetry breaking) cannot reconnect them. Parameterization-freeness is automatic and total: pi_0 is a homotopy functor, invariant under any re-coordinatization of G — this is the manifestly parameterization-free case the success criterion named, and it survives. Residual declarations are ambient laws or physical conditions, not per-exemplar choices: locality is constitutive; the U(1) is the ambient gauge theory's own conservation law (and dischargeable to the mobility-gap disordered setting via Bellissard–van Elst–Schulz-Baldes, per the kernel file). Honest caveats kept: finite-range vs exponentially-decaying-tail class equivalence is expected and covered case-by-case, not proven in full generality; spectral vs mobility gap is a scoped condition. Boundary, stated exactly: F1 holds for class-maximal invariants (Chern, chiral central charge, anyon data — topological order proper) and fails for declaration-created distinctions (SPTs); R_K as priced is on the surviving side, so the CLASS is a supplied input to the E3 TYPE but not to this exemplar's Phi.

per_exemplar.exemplar: E4 — zeta / primordial amplitude (Phi = asymptotic projection onto the frozen slow manifold)
per_exemplar.finding: CANONICAL — the strongest of the five, in three stacked senses. (1) Gauge/slicing choice is coordinate choice ON the image: zeta (uniform-density) and R (comoving) are each Bardeen-style gauge-invariant variables, and they coincide identically on im(Phi) — super-horizon adiabatic modes — differing only at O(k^2/(aH)^2) or when delta-p_nad != 0, i.e. exactly and only where the projection has not yet acted or fails; and the failure locus (USR/non-adiabatic) is derivable and already internal to the object's own statement (the recorded basin boundary). So 'zeta is gauge-invariant' is not merely consistent with canonicality here — the degeneration of the slicing ambiguity on the image is precisely what canonicality of an asymptotic projection means. (2) Theory-independence beyond presentation-independence: Wands–Malik–Lyth–Liddle (PRD 62, 043527 (2000), equation-level in the kernel file) derive zeta-dot proportional to delta-p_nad + O(k^2) from local energy-momentum conservation ALONE, without Einstein's equations, and Weinberg's adiabatic-mode theorem guarantees the frozen mode's existence for k->0 in any theory realizing the dilatation — zeta is the Goldstone of a large gauge transformation. Phi survives changing the gravity theory: no other exemplar's Phi has protection at that grade. (3) The cross-presentation probe (the analog of E1's on-shell attack, and the G-round precedent operating in the benign direction): the boundary/bootstrap presentation — late-time correlators constrained directly by de Sitter symmetry, no bulk flow anywhere — does not delete Phi's content but translates it: the two-solutions-one-annihilated structure reappears as the boundary fall-off data (only one fall-off's coefficient survives at the late boundary), and the round's type-derivation (one power spectrum per mode, not two) is concordant across presentations. Same content as flow / as boundary condition — presentation moves, image dimension presentation-absolute.

per_exemplar.exemplar: E5 — Bath sufficient statistic (Phi = factorization of environments through (J(omega), beta)) — route-1 probe only; the main attack is route 2's
per_exemplar.finding: Conditionally CANONICAL — given the flagged model class — with two chart-level footnotes and no NEW route-1 failure. Given the Gaussian/linear-coupling class, the influence functional is an operationally defined, presentation-free object, and its exact factorization through the coupling-weighted bath correlation function is Feynman–Vernon theorem-grade: canonical relative to the class. The route-1 residue is at the level of COORDINATES on im(Phi), not of Phi: (a) J is defined relative to the normalization of the system coupling operator — only the pair's combination entering C(t) is invariant; (b) for degenerate spectra (J supported at isolated frequencies) beta and J(omega_0) are not separately identifiable — only coth-weighted combinations enter — so (J, beta) is a generically-faithful chart (faithful for full-support J via the KMS ratio), with measure-zero degeneracy. Chart degeneracy on a canonical image, not presentation-relativity of the map. The genuine suppliedness — the model class itself — is exactly the residue F1 already flags and prices in its own text, which is what E2 lacks and why E2 fails where E5 does not; adjudicating that flag's sustainability (can the class be moved law-side or state-side?) is route 2's assignment, not this route's.

routes.argument: The attack was run at the strongest available points and in both directions. The naive reading of F1 — 'the factorization map itself is presentation-absolute' — is DEAD, killed by E1: on-shell/invariant presentations of flavor physics exhibit the same physics with no G_F quotient anywhere (the domain of Yukawa tensors never exists, so the 26-dimensional fibre and the many-to-one character are covering-presentation bookkeeping), which is the G-round warning (same content as contour/saddle/boundary condition) realized inside F's best exemplar. But the kill does not propagate to F, for a reason the attack itself uncovered and which is the route's main structural finding: quotient-free presentations must IMPORT as unproved axioms exactly the image structure (dimension 13 = Krull dimension of the invariant ring, syzygies, |J| bounds) that the quotient presentation DERIVES — F3 is what makes Phi non-idle, and canonicality survives in the narrowed two-part sense: presentation-absolute image + category-forced map within every presentation class containing the domain, with concordance of the image across all known presentations (spurion, BBG invariants, on-shell) and no known presentation yielding a different image. E3 survives the class attack in the strongest available sense — the Chern instance is class-maximal (Hastings–Michalakis need no symmetry declaration beyond the ambient U(1)), and pi_0 is a homotopy functor, hence manifestly parameterization-free — while the attack succeeds against the E3 TYPE (SPT distinctions are declaration-created; tenfold way = the dependence table), drawing a sharp, non-post-hoc boundary. E4 is canonical outright and most strongly: slicing ambiguity degenerates identically on the image, the projection is derived from local conservation alone (gravity-theory-independent), and the bootstrap presentation translates rather than deletes the structure. E5 is canonical given its already-flagged class. The genuine failure is E2: its Phi is a family indexed by the system-environment split, a supplied presentation datum whose canonical derivation is an open research problem (Carroll–Singh; with published non-uniqueness arguments), which the program's own ledger already classified as contraction-defining type-error — yet F1's text grants E2 no choice-residue flag while granting E5 one. F1 as stated is therefore false at E2 and imprecise everywhere; it survives as F1' (see narrowed form) with E2 demoted to conditional status.
